title: bug: a REVIEW row the qa_reject hard cap parked for a human (needsHumanReview) is fenced only at claim time, so any worker, QA or governor seat can qa_approve it to DONE with no claim and no get_context, qa_reject it again, or release_task it back into the QA queue, and get_context's nextAction points a QA seat at qa_approve
description:
Filed by defect hunt #15 (task-928a468d), lane 1 (the QA review-loop escalation). Verified at HEAD d5431577 in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout.

PROBLEM
- Past the cap, qa_reject parks the row. Status stays REVIEW, the assignee is cleared and needsHumanReview is set true (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaReject.ts:295-298).
- Only claim_next_task (claimNextTask.ts:574, plus its ranked-pool exclusion) and wait_for_task (waitForTask.ts:146, :180) honour the flag.
- qa_approve and qa_reject never read needsHumanReview. Their guards no-op on an unassigned row: assertWorkerOwns returns at util/enforcement.ts:44 and assertContextFetched at :240. So a seat that never claimed or read the row passes both guards.
  - qa_approve then writes DONE and clears the flag (qaApprove.ts:231-236).
  - qa_reject re-rejects it (reopenCount 4 → 5).
- release_task's already-unassigned branch clears needsHumanReview for any caller (releaseTask.ts:250-264). assertReleaseCaller no-ops on an unassigned row (util/claimGuards.ts:293). So a worker seat puts the row back in the QA queue.
- get_context's nextAction for every REVIEW row is moe.qa_approve (util/contextNextAction.ts:57-59), parked or not.

CONTRACT
- qaReject.ts:412 (the park message): "A human must reopen or approve it; it is excluded from the QA queue until then." claimNextTask.ts:577 says the same.
- types/schema.ts:1131-1136: the row is excluded from the QA claim pool "until a human clears it (qa_approve / set_task_status reopen / release_task / board move)".
- docs/roles/governor.md:33 (the ❌ row): the daemon "parks it in REVIEW for a human past that".
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md:2106 (### moe.release_task): release_task is "one of the documented human unpark paths".

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-928a468d/A/parkedReviewAgentBypass.test.ts. Copy it into packages/moe-daemon/src/__hunt__/ of a d5431577 snapshot and run `npx vitest run src/__hunt__/parkedReviewAgentBypass.test.ts`.
- The test parks a row with four real qa_reject calls, then calls each tool from a seat that never claimed the row. Result: 4 failed, 1 passed. The passing case is the workerId-less human control.
  - qa_approve by qa-b: expected refused true, "status": "REVIEW", "needsHumanReview": true. Received refused false, "status": "DONE", "needsHumanReview": undefined.
  - get_context by qa-b gives nextAction moe.qa_approve, and following it lands the same DONE.
  - qa_reject by qa-b: received "reopenCount": 5. Expected 4 and a refusal.
  - release_task by worker-x: received "needsHumanReview": false.
- Output: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-928a468d/A/parkedReviewAgentBypass.vitest.txt
- Exposure: no live row has needsHumanReview today, and the highest QA-driven reopenCount is 3. This is a guard gap, not a live incident, but the park is the only terminating tier of the reject loop.

FIX DIRECTION
- Keep the deliberate unassigned no-op of assertWorkerOwns and assertContextFetched; util/enforcement.ts:62-68 lists the tools that rely on it.
- Add one park-specific refusal that mirrors claimNextTask.ts:574. On a REVIEW row with needsHumanReview true, refuse with NOT_ALLOWED any call that supplies a workerId, before any write. Apply it in qa_approve, in qa_reject, and in release_task's unpark branch. The workerId-less human/IDE path keeps working.
- get_context returns no moe.qa_approve nextAction for a parked row: either no hint, or one saying a human owns it.
- Before tightening, grep the existing callers. Checked at hunt time: no current test clears a park with a workerId. qaReject.test.ts:177-187 re-rejects an ASSIGNED row with no flag. releaseTask.test.ts:272 unparks with no workerId.

FILES (6, at the warn line; the get_context hint is the same contract)

- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaReject.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/releaseTask.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/contextNextAction.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/parkedReview.guard.test.ts (new; one vitest file for all four)
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md: sync your own sections, `### moe.qa_approve`, `### moe.qa_reject` and `### moe.release_task`. The qa_reject Returns block (:2353) should also list status "REVIEW" and the parkedForHuman and needsHumanReview keys that the park already returns (qaReject.ts:419-424).

Placement: no open row holds these files at filing time. A held-back lead also edits qaReject.ts: the cap counts reopens from any path, so a human reopen onto the cap skips the architect re-plan. That lead waits for this row.
